# JM Remodeling & Construction, LLC

> Award-winning, design-build residential and commercial remodeler serving the Greater Milwaukee area of Southeastern Wisconsin since 1990. Licensed, bonded, and insured, with in-house journeymen across every trade.

## About

- **Business:** JM Remodeling & Construction, LLC
- **Founded:** 1990 (35+ years in business)
- **Location:** 7701 N. Teutonia Ave., Milwaukee, WI 53209
- **Phone:** (414) 354-2800
- **Email:** customerservice@jmremodelingwi.com
- **Hours:** Mon–Fri 7am–6pm, Sat 8am–2pm, Sun closed
- **Service area:** Greater Milwaukee / Southeastern Wisconsin — Milwaukee, Waukesha, Brookfield, Wauwatosa, Mequon, Oconomowoc, Pewaukee, and Menomonee Falls.

## Credentials

- NARI award-winning remodeler
- Better Business Bureau (BBB) member
- National Roofing Contractors Association (NRCA) member
- Certified installers for vinyl siding, windows, and roofing
- Licensed, bonded, and insured
- In-house journeymen: carpenters, plumbers, electricians, roofers, siders, and sheet-metal workers, plus an apprenticeship program
- Fixed-price contracts, labor/factory/extended warranties, and a 30-day labor price lock on kitchens

## Services

- [Kitchen Remodeling](/services/kitchen-remodeling): Custom cabinetry, countertops, islands, and full gut renovations.
- [Bathroom Remodeling](/services/bathroom-remodeling): Walk-in showers, tub-to-shower conversions, custom tile, and vanities.
- [Basement Finishing](/services/basement-finishing): Home theaters, wet bars, guest suites, gyms, egress, and waterproofing.
- [Roofing & Siding](/services/roofing-siding): Asphalt and metal roofing, vinyl and fiber-cement siding, gutters, and storm repair.
- [Additions & Framing](/services/additions-framing): Room and second-story additions, sunrooms, garage conversions, and structural framing.
- [Commercial Buildouts](/services/commercial-buildouts): Turn-key offices, retail, restaurants, medical suites, and multi-family remodels.

## Offers

- $2,000 off tub-to-shower conversions
- Up to 10% off for active military and homeowners 65+
- Financing: 0% interest if paid in full within 18 months, or as low as 5.99% long-term (subject to credit approval)
